ns2:section.sectionText: Sections AB1, AB2, AB3, AB4 meets January 18 through February 22, a nonstandard-term course within the first five weeks of the semester. Section BB1, BB2, BB3, BB4 meets March 1 through April 5, a nonstandard-term course within the second five weeks of the semester. Course adds and section changes beginning January 18 (for sections AB1, AB2, AB3, AB4) and beginning March 1 (for sections BB1, BB2, BB3, BB4) and course drops after January 18 and March 2 require GE Department approval (209 Trans Bld). LBD section meeting times and location will be announced in LBD section meeting times and location will be announced in the first lecture.
